diff --git a/lib/allocator_one/harness/reviews/severity_fallback_recovery.ex b/lib/allocator_one/harness/reviews/severity_fallback_recovery.ex

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..29a14219c20f3694e70b02f660388c9444291f48
--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/allocator_one/harness/reviews/severity_fallback_recovery.ex
@@ -0,0 +1,210 @@
+defmodule AllocatorOne.Harness.Reviews.SeverityFallbackRecovery do
+  @moduledoc """
+  Validates the one legacy severity-gating recovery protocol.
+
+  Review Council 4.4.7 could finish a healthy verified-consensus run after
+  verifier consensus failed, fall back to the finding severity, and emit no
+  public gating labels. Recovery is accepted only when the immutable source
+  report and its recorded provenance identify that exact producer behavior.
+  """
+
+  @reason "severity-fallback"
+  @source_version "4.4.7"
+  @descriptor_keys ~w(
+    cause
+    source_envelope_sha256
+    source_manifest_sha256
+    source_mode
+    source_rcl_version
+    source_report_sha256
+    version
+  )
+  @sha256 ~r/\A[0-9a-f]{64}\z/
+
+  @doc "The protocol-specific gating reason stored for legacy severity fallback."
+  @spec reason() :: String.t()
+  def reason, do: @reason
+
+  @doc "Returns the stored recovery descriptor, when this run declares one."
+  @spec descriptor(map()) :: map() | nil
+  def descriptor(%{gating: gating}), do: descriptor(gating)
+  def descriptor(%{"gating" => gating}), do: descriptor(gating)
+  def descriptor(%{} = gating), do: gating["severity_fallback_recovery"]
+  def descriptor(_value), do: nil
+
+  @doc "Validates recovered run fields before any evidence is stored."
+  @spec validate_envelope(map(), [map()], map()) :: :ok | {:error, {:invalid, String.t()}}
+  def validate_envelope(run, findings, stats) do
+    recovery = descriptor(run)
+    reasons = Enum.map(findings, & &1.gating_reason)
+
+    cond do
+      is_nil(recovery) and @reason not in reasons ->
+        :ok
+
+      is_nil(recovery) ->
+        invalid("severity-fallback requires source recovery provenance")
+
+      @reason not in reasons ->
+        invalid("severity-fallback recovery must recover at least one actionable finding")
+
+      true ->
+        validate_recovery(run, findings, stats, recovery)
+    end
+  end
+
+  @doc "Checks the immutable original report header for the declared recovery."
+  @spec validate_source_report(map(), map()) :: :ok | {:error, :binding_conflict}
+  def validate_source_report(run, report) do
+    with %{} = recovery <- descriptor(run),
+         %{"run" => %{} = header, "stats" => %{} = stats} <- report,
+         true <- source_findings_unlabeled?(report),
+         true <- header["rcl_version"] == @source_version,
+         true <- get_in(header, ["gating", "mode"]) == "verified-consensus",
+         true <- source_header_bound?(run, header),
+         true <- not Map.has_key?(stats, "verification"),
+         true <- get_in(stats, ["blockingHealth", "conclusive"]) == true,
+         true <- stats == run.stats,
+         true <- recovery["source_report_sha256"] == run.report_json_sha256 do
+      :ok
+    else
+      _ -> {:error, :binding_conflict}
+    end
+  end
+
+  @doc "Derives the only allowed recovered reason from immutable source fields."
+  @spec expected_reason(map(), boolean()) :: String.t()
+  def expected_reason(%{"severity" => severity}, false) when severity in ~w(critical important), do: @reason
+  def expected_reason(_finding, _below_threshold), do: "none"
+
+  @doc "Whether a stored run uses the severity fallback recovery protocol."
+  @spec recovered?(map()) :: boolean()
+  def recovered?(run), do: is_map(descriptor(run))
+
+  @doc "Whether the run's source report was verified and durably stored."
+  @spec source_verified?(map()) :: boolean()
+  def source_verified?(run) do
+    not recovered?(run) or verified_report_artifact?(run)
+  end
+
+  defp source_findings_unlabeled?(report) do
+    with kept when is_list(kept) <- report["findings"],
+         below when is_list(below) <- Map.get(report, "belowThresholdFindings", []) do
+      Enum.all?(kept ++ below, &(is_map(&1) and is_nil(&1["gating"])))
+    else
+      _ -> false
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp source_header_bound?(run, header) do
+    header["command"] == run.command and
+      header["config_sha256"] == run.config_sha256 and
+      header["roster"] == run.roster and
+      header["thresholds"] == run.thresholds and
+      header["gating"] == Map.delete(run.gating, "severity_fallback_recovery") and
+      header["spec"] == optional_block(%{"source" => run.spec_source, "sha256" => run.spec_sha256}) and
+      Map.get(header, "context_files", []) == run.context_files and
+      header["plan"] == run.plan and
+      header["runner"] == run.runner and
+      header["duration_ms"] == run.duration_ms and
+      header["ci_exit_code"] == run.ci_exit_code and
+      converge_bound?(run, header["converge"]) and
+      datetime_bound?(run.started_at, header["started_at"]) and
+      datetime_bound?(run.finished_at, header["finished_at"])
+  end
+
+  defp converge_bound?(run, converge) do
+    converge ==
+      optional_block(%{
+        "target" => run.converge_target,
+        "round" => run.converge_round,
+        "attempt" => run.converge_attempt
+      })
+  end
+
+  defp datetime_bound?(%DateTime{} = expected, encoded) when is_binary(encoded) do
+    case DateTime.from_iso8601(encoded) do
+      {:ok, actual, _offset} -> DateTime.compare(expected, actual) == :eq
+      _ -> false
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp datetime_bound?(_expected, _encoded), do: false
+
+  defp compact(map), do: Map.reject(map, fn {_key, value} -> is_nil(value) end)
+
+  defp optional_block(map) do
+    case compact(map) do
+      empty when map_size(empty) == 0 -> nil
+      block -> block
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp validate_recovery(run, findings, stats, recovery) do
+    with :ok <- descriptor_shape(recovery),
+         :ok <- source_binding(run, recovery),
+         :ok <- source_health(stats) do
+      finding_projection(findings)
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp descriptor_shape(recovery) when is_map(recovery) do
+    valid? =
+      recovery |> Map.keys() |> Enum.sort() == @descriptor_keys and
+        recovery["version"] == 1 and
+        recovery["cause"] == "verification_pass_failed" and
+        recovery["source_rcl_version"] == @source_version and
+        recovery["source_mode"] == "asserted" and
+        Enum.all?(~w(source_report_sha256 source_envelope_sha256 source_manifest_sha256), fn key ->
+          is_binary(recovery[key]) and Regex.match?(@sha256, recovery[key])
+        end)
+
+    if valid?, do: :ok, else: invalid("severity-fallback recovery provenance is invalid")
+  end
+
+  defp descriptor_shape(_recovery), do: invalid("severity-fallback recovery provenance is invalid")
+
+  defp verified_report_artifact?(run) do
+    declared = Enum.find(Map.get(run, :artifacts_declared, []), &(&1["kind"] == "report_json"))
+
+    case Map.get(run, :artifacts) do
+      artifacts when is_list(artifacts) ->
+        Enum.any?(artifacts, fn artifact ->
+          artifact.kind == "report_json" and is_map(declared) and artifact.sha256 == run.report_json_sha256 and
+            artifact.sha256 == declared["sha256"] and artifact.byte_size == declared["bytes"]
+        end)
+
+      _not_loaded ->
+        false
+    end
+  end
+
+  defp source_binding(run, recovery) do
+    valid? =
+      run.rcl_version == @source_version and
+        get_in(run.gating, ["mode"]) == "verified-consensus" and
+        recovery["source_report_sha256"] == run.report_json_sha256
+
+    if valid?, do: :ok, else: invalid("severity-fallback source binding is invalid")
+  end
+
+  defp source_health(stats) do
+    valid? =
+      not Map.has_key?(stats, "verification") and
+        get_in(stats, ["blockingHealth", "conclusive"]) == true
+
+    if valid?, do: :ok, else: invalid("severity-fallback requires conclusive health without verifier consensus")
+  end
+
+  defp finding_projection(findings) do
+    if Enum.all?(findings, fn finding ->
+         finding.gating_reason == expected_reason(%{"severity" => finding.severity}, finding.below_threshold) and
+           is_nil(finding.verification_verdict) and is_nil(finding.verification_model) and
+           is_nil(finding.verification_note)
+       end),
+       do: :ok,
+       else: invalid("severity-fallback findings must match their immutable severity projection")
+  end
+
+  defp invalid(message), do: {:error, {:invalid, message}}
+end

+          :error -> standing?(finding, run, standing, aliases, graph) or lent?(finding, lenders)
+        end
+      end)
+      |> Enum.map(fn finding ->
+        case Map.get(corrections, finding.ref) do
+          %{source: :semantic_split, identity: identity} -> %{finding | claim_identity: identity}
+          _ -> finding
+        end
+      end)
+    else
+      []
+    end
   end
 
   def actionable(%Run{}, _verdicts, _aliases, _graph, _corrections, _sources), do: []

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..c62c0ad7e1bd020d3ba1ec28b30b378d73b32596
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/allocator_one/harness/reviews/severity_fallback_recovery_test.exs
@@ -0,0 +1,245 @@
+defmodule AllocatorOne.Harness.Reviews.SeverityFallbackRecoveryTest do
+  use AllocatorOne.DataCase, async: true
+
+  import AllocatorOne.HarnessReviewFixtures
+
+  alias AllocatorOne.Harness.Reviews
+  alias AllocatorOne.Harness.Reviews.Envelope
+  alias AllocatorOne.Harness.Reviews.RecoverySource
+  alias AllocatorOne.Harness.Reviews.SeverityFallbackRecovery
+  alias AllocatorOne.Harness.Reviews.Status
+
+  @source_envelope_sha String.duplicate("e", 64)
+  @source_manifest_sha String.duplicate("f", 64)
+
+  test "accepts only the source-bound strict severity projection" do
+    {envelope, _report, _bytes} = recovery_fixture()
+
+    assert {:ok, parsed} = Envelope.parse(envelope)
+
+    assert Enum.map(parsed.findings, &{&1.severity, &1.below_threshold, &1.gating_reason}) == [
+             {"important", false, "severity-fallback"},
+             {"critical", false, "severity-fallback"},
+             {"minor", false, "none"},
+             {"important", true, "none"}
+           ]
+
+    for changed <- [
+          put_in(envelope, ["run", "gating", "severity_fallback_recovery"], "invalid"),
+          put_in(envelope, ["run", "rcl_version"], "4.4.8"),
+          update_in(envelope, ["run", "gating"], &Map.delete(&1, "severity_fallback_recovery")),
+          put_in(envelope, ["run", "gating", "mode"], "all-findings"),
+          put_in(
+            envelope,
+            ["run", "gating", "severity_fallback_recovery", "source_envelope_sha256"],
+            String.duplicate("0", 63)
+          ),
+          put_in(envelope, ["stats", "verification"], %{"candidates" => 1}),
+          put_in(envelope, ["stats", "blockingHealth", "conclusive"], false),
+          put_in(envelope, ["findings", Access.at(0), "gating_reason"], "none"),
+          put_in(envelope, ["findings", Access.at(2), "gating_reason"], "severity-fallback"),
+          put_in(envelope, ["findings", Access.at(3), "gating_reason"], "severity-fallback")
+        ] do
+      assert {:error, {:invalid, message}} = Envelope.parse(changed)
+      assert message =~ "severity-fallback"
+    end
+  end
+
+  test "stores and verifies the unchanged legacy report before exposing its severity fallback" do
+    org = AllocatorOne.OrgsFixtures.org_fixture()
+    enable_reviews(org)
+    {envelope, _report, bytes} = recovery_fixture()
+
+    assert {:ok, run, :created} = Reviews.record_run(org, envelope, %{})
+    assert {:ok, pending} = Reviews.get_run(org, run.client_id)
+    pending = eligible_with_healthy_calls(pending)
+    refute SeverityFallbackRecovery.source_verified?(pending)
+    assert Status.actionable(pending, []) == []
+
+    assert %{status: :inconclusive, conclusive: false, actionable: []} =
+             Status.compute(:advisory, pending.head_sha, [pending], [])
+
+    assert {:ok, artifact, :created} = Reviews.store_artifact(org, run.client_id, "report_json", bytes)
+    assert {:ok, loaded} = Reviews.get_run(org, run.client_id)
+    loaded = eligible_with_healthy_calls(loaded)
+    assert SeverityFallbackRecovery.source_verified?(loaded)
+    assert {:ok, evidence} = RecoverySource.verify(loaded, artifact, bytes)
+    assert Enum.map(evidence, & &1.ref) == ~w(f001 f002 f003 f004)
+
+    assert Enum.map(Status.actionable(loaded, []), & &1.ref) == ~w(f001 f002)
+    assert %{status: :unresolved, conclusive: true} = Status.compute(:advisory, loaded.head_sha, [loaded], [])
+    assert {:ok, ^bytes} = Reviews.read_artifact(artifact)
+  end
+
+  test "refuses conflicting source labels and preserves idempotent binding" do
+    org = AllocatorOne.OrgsFixtures.org_fixture()
+    enable_reviews(org)
+    {envelope, report, bytes} = recovery_fixture()
+
+    assert {:ok, run, :created} = Reviews.record_run(org, envelope, %{})
+    assert {:ok, same, :existing} = Reviews.record_run(org, envelope, %{})
+    assert same.id == run.id
+
+    changed_binding =
+      put_in(
+        envelope,
+        ["run", "gating", "severity_fallback_recovery", "source_manifest_sha256"],
+        String.duplicate("1", 64)
+      )
+
+    assert {:error, :conflict} = Reviews.record_run(org, changed_binding, %{})
+
+    changed_finding = put_in(envelope, ["findings", Access.at(0), "title"], "Changed recovered title")
+    assert {:error, :conflict} = Reviews.record_run(org, changed_finding, %{})
+
+    labeled = put_in(report, ["findings", Access.at(0), "gating"], %{"reason" => "critical"})
+    labeled_bytes = JSON.encode!(labeled)
+    assert byte_size(labeled_bytes) != byte_size(bytes) or sha256(labeled_bytes) != sha256(bytes)
+
+    # Even if a malicious caller declares the conflicting bytes on a fresh run,
+    # source validation rejects the already-labeled report before persistence.
+    {other, _report, _bytes} = recovery_fixture()
+    other = put_in(other, ["run", "id"], Ecto.UUID.generate())
+
+    other =
+      put_in(other, ["artifacts_declared", Access.at(0)], %{
+        "kind" => "report_json",
+        "sha256" => sha256(labeled_bytes),
+        "bytes" => byte_size(labeled_bytes)
+      })
+
+    other = put_in(other, ["run", "gating", "severity_fallback_recovery", "source_report_sha256"], sha256(labeled_bytes))
+    assert {:ok, other_run, :created} = Reviews.record_run(org, other, %{})
+    assert {:error, :binding_conflict} = Reviews.store_artifact(org, other_run.client_id, "report_json", labeled_bytes)
+    assert {:ok, loaded} = Reviews.get_run(org, other_run.client_id)
+    assert loaded.artifacts == []
+    assert Status.actionable(loaded, []) == []
+
+    changed_source = put_in(report, ["findings", Access.at(0), "title"], "Different source title")
+    changed_source_bytes = JSON.encode!(changed_source)
+    {third, _report, _bytes} = recovery_fixture()
+    third = bind_source_bytes(third, changed_source_bytes)
+    third = put_in(third, ["run", "id"], Ecto.UUID.generate())
+    assert {:ok, third_run, :created} = Reviews.record_run(org, third, %{})
+
+    assert {:error, :binding_conflict} =
+             Reviews.store_artifact(org, third_run.client_id, "report_json", changed_source_bytes)
+  end
+
+  defp recovery_fixture do
+    base = envelope()
+    id = base["run"]["id"]
+
+    findings = [
+      finding("f001", "important", false, "severity-fallback", "a"),
+      finding("f002", "critical", false, "severity-fallback", "b"),
+      finding("f003", "minor", false, "none", "c"),
+      finding("f004", "important", true, "none", "d")
+    ]
+
+    source_findings = Enum.map(findings, &source_finding/1)
+
+    original_run =
+      base["run"]
+      |> Map.put("id", id)
+      |> Map.put("rcl_version", "4.4.7")
+      |> put_in(["gating", "mode"], "verified-consensus")
+
+    stats =
+      base["stats"]
+      |> Map.delete("verification")
+      |> Map.put("blockingHealth", %{
+        "version" => 1,
+        "fraction" => 2 / 3,
+        "seats" => 3,
+        "required" => 2,
+        "successful" => 2,
+        "conclusive" => true,
+        "excludedSuccesses" => %{"secondary" => 0, "async" => 0, "verification" => 0}
+      })
+
+    report = %{
+      "run" => original_run,
+      "reviews" => base["calls"],
+      "findings" => Enum.reject(source_findings, & &1["belowThreshold"]),
+      "belowThresholdFindings" => Enum.filter(source_findings, & &1["belowThreshold"]),
+      "stats" => stats
+    }
+
+    bytes = JSON.encode!(report)
+    report_sha = sha256(bytes)
+
+    recovery = %{
+      "version" => 1,
+      "cause" => "verification_pass_failed",
+      "source_rcl_version" => "4.4.7",
+      "source_mode" => "asserted",
+      "source_report_sha256" => report_sha,
+      "source_envelope_sha256" => @source_envelope_sha,
+      "source_manifest_sha256" => @source_manifest_sha
+    }
+
+    recovered_run = put_in(original_run, ["gating", "severity_fallback_recovery"], recovery)
+
+    recovered = %{
+      base
+      | "run" => recovered_run,
+        "findings" => Enum.map(findings, &Map.delete(&1, "belowThreshold")),
+        "stats" => stats,
+        "artifacts_declared" => [%{"kind" => "report_json", "sha256" => report_sha, "bytes" => byte_size(bytes)}]
+    }
+
+    {recovered, report, bytes}
+  end
+
+  defp finding(ref, severity, below, gating, suffix) do
+    %{
+      "ref" => ref,
+      "identity_key" => String.duplicate(suffix, 16),
+      "file" => "src/#{suffix}.ts",
+      "start_line" => 10,
+      "end_line" => 10,
+      "severity" => severity,
+      "category" => "correctness",
+      "title" => "Finding #{suffix}",
+      "description" => "Description #{suffix}",
+      "consensus" => %{"score" => 1, "models" => ["model-a"]},
+      "gating_reason" => gating,
+      "below_threshold" => below,
+      "belowThreshold" => below

+
+  defp source_finding(finding) do
+    %{
+      "id" => finding["ref"],
+      "identity" => finding["identity_key"],
+      "file" => finding["file"],
+      "startLine" => finding["start_line"],
+      "endLine" => finding["end_line"],

+      "category" => finding["category"],

+  defp bind_source_bytes(envelope, bytes) do

+
+    envelope
+    |> put_in(["artifacts_declared", Access.at(0)], %{

spec:
# Spec: Accept source-bound legacy severity-fallback review evidence

## Description
Review Council 4.4.7 run 01a0ee2a-d7b2-7062-bf75-51780915dd8b completed conclusive reviewer health, then its whole verification pass failed. The legacy producer intentionally fell back to strict severity gating but emitted a verified-consensus report with missing public gating labels and a retained wire envelope that normalized them to none. Current Harness must not accept that envelope because it would project zero actionable findings.

Add a narrowly authenticated recovery protocol for the truthful gating reason severity-fallback. It represents only a retained legacy producer's whole-pass failure and keeps actionability derived from each immutable finding's original severity. It must never imply consensus or verifier confirmation and must not make ordinary missing labels recoverable.

The server-side protocol must land and release before the RCL-153 client emits this reason. RCL-153 and IO-13868 remain blocked until both halves ship.

## Acceptance criteria
1. Accept severity-fallback only through an explicit recovery envelope whose source descriptor binds the original run id, target/head/base, report SHA-256, envelope SHA-256, producer version, original report mode, and deterministic recovery version.
2. Prove the original retained report is verified-consensus with missing gating labels, no verification summary, conclusive health, and a producer version known to use strict severity fallback after whole-pass failure; reject malformed, missing, contradictory, already-labeled, or unrelated reports.
3. Derive actionability from immutable original severity: critical and important kept findings remain actionable; minor/nitpick and every below-threshold finding do not. Never upgrade evidence to consensus or verified.
4. Store and serialize severity-fallback without changing the run id, finding identities, native attempt/round state, or original source hashes. Conflicting replay refuses; exact replay is idempotent.
5. Add controller/envelope/status/readback tests, ship through exact-head RCL, enforced evidence, CI, protected backend release, and verify the public API before RCL-153 client release.

## Design
